The primary bedroom also features French doors leading directly to the backyard deck, offering a private retreat with easy outdoor access. A welcoming covered front porch adds to the home€s curb appeal and provides the perfect place to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind in the evening. Inside, you€ll find comfortable living spaces filled with natural light and a functional layout ideal for both daily living and hosting guests. Conveniently located near parks, shopping, dining, and schools, this home offers the perfect combination of comfort, charm, and outdoor enjoyment.
